findings.finding: triage coverage: 6 problem(s) reported, 6 classified as a defect class, 6 carried an explicit `kind` tag. Unclassified ones are recorded as judgement calls and owe no answer — which is also what a deck in a language the keyword sets do not cover looks like from here.
findings.resolution: Reviewed as an advisory; original wording retained in the blind answer and full log.

findings.finding: the design plan sets `icon_family: none`, and the reader saw ZERO icons across all 5 slides. Either they never reached the build, or they are too small/faint to register.
findings.resolution: False positive in CLI none handling, supported by original source and rendered pages; upstream left unmodified.
findings.refuted: Checked all five PNGs: zero pictographic icons is intended and agrees with icon_family=none. The upstream CLI passes raw design_plan to compare at blind_read.py main, bypassing planned_icon_family(record), whose documented none-handling returns an empty family. Thus it incorrectly interprets the literal none as a planned icon family. Reader accurately saw zero icons; no missing planned asset exists.
